slides.texte_overlay:
trends i'm quietly skipping
this year (and why)

1. a new planner every january
one notebook, used to
the last page.

2. posting every meal
the best dinners stay between
the people who were there.

3. being busy as a personality
calm is more impressive.

4. replying in seconds
replying kindly beats
replying fast.

5. a new hobby every week
one hobby for years beats
ten for a week.

6. scrolling in bed at night
instead: a book, a painting,
a story from history.

6. scrolling in bed at night
instead: 5 minutes on an app
like Sophia.
